item.title: The file that kept the light
item.description:
There is a file in this repo that nobody opens for pleasure: tools/routing.json. It is the map of every app — id, name, url, description, tags, folder, category, fields, status, and who consumes what. It reads like plumbing. Today it behaved like a lamp.

This is the story of a long polishing session that began with colours, went down into every app in apps/, and ended up re-mining that file from a side we had left in the dark. By the end, the plumbing was checking itself every time we publish.

item.title: Standards — the grammar underneath
item.description: A language isn’t beautiful because every sentence is beautiful; it’s useful because the grammar underneath is agreed on. The standards shelf is flove’s grammar — the rules the whole workshop quietly agrees to so that a human and a machine can build together in the same voice, on the same ground, without having to re-decide everything twice. It’s the least glamorous shelf and the one that makes every other shelf possible.
